params.name: Pagination and Search Configuration Options

params.name: Provider Search Criteria
params.description: Search criteria based on aspects of the providers themselves.

params.name: Location Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on the locations at which they practice.

params.name: Insurance Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on the insurances they accept.

params.name: Specialty Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on their specialties.

params.name: Procedure Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on procedures they perform.

params.name: Focus Area Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on their Focus Areas.

params.name: Cost and Quality Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on Cost and Quality scores.

params.name: Organization Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on the organizations they belong to.

params.name: TINs Search Criteria
params.description: Criteria used to search for providers based on the TINs they are associated with.

items.docs: Allows you to quickly list doctors based on important search criteria.

params.name: npi
params.description: The 10-digit National Provider Identifier (NPI) of the healthcare provider to fetch.

params.name: max_insurances
params.description: If provided, returns only up to this many insurances per location. Useful to limit the amount of data returned when you do not need the entire list of accepted insurances.

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information for any provider given their NPI, such as locations, contact information, education, patient satisfaction, etc.

Edit all fields that do not fall under `specialties`, `locations`, or `insurances`. You may also add new fields or remove existing fields.

#### Looking For The Old Documentation?
We're in the process of revamping our documentation. You can find the old page for this endpoint [here](https://ribbon.readme.io/docs/add-or-edit-provider-fields-old).
Add or remove locations a provider practices at using our standard location UUIDs.

Edit all fields that do not fall under `uuid`, `google_maps_link`, `latitude`, or `longitude`. You may also add new fields or remove existing fields.
These updates are provider-specific and will not affect other providers practicing at the same location.
Add or remove specialties for a provider using our standard specialty UUIDs.
Edit whether a single specialty is one of the provider's primary specialties.
Add or remove procedures for a provider using our standard procedure UUIDs.
